head: cloud/compat-stream-boolean
title: fix(serve): accept a boolean or null stream on compatibility routes
body:
`ReadCompatibilityOptions` validates `stream`, `echo`, `store` and `background` in one loop. On `/v1/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/messages` and `/v1/messages/count_tokens`, where `stream: true` is allowed, any non-boolean `stream` got `400 "'stream' must be false"`:

- `"stream": "true"` was told to be `false`, though `true` is accepted.
- `"stream": null` was rejected. Chat Completions (`openai_chat.cpp`, `ParseRequest`) treats a null `stream` as unset and reports other non-booleans as `'stream' must be a boolean`.

With this change, routes that allow streaming handle `stream` the same way Chat Completions does. Null leaves streaming off, and any other non-boolean gets `'stream' must be a boolean`. `echo`, `store` and `background` are unchanged. So is `stream` on routes without streaming (`/completion`), which still must be absent or `false`.

Messages rejects `stop_sequences: null` on purpose. If you would rather Messages also reject `stream: null`, I can limit the null case to the OpenAI-shaped routes.

`TestCompatibilityRequests` now checks each streaming route twice: `"stream":"true"` returns 400 with the boolean message, and `"stream":null` returns a buffered JSON reply.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending. The change is in HTTP request validation only, so no GPU path is touched.

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope (x86-64 CPU host, GCC 13.3, `cpu-test` preset, no GPU):
- Before the source change, the new test failed: `http_server_test` asserted at the `'stream' must be a boolean` check. After it, `ctest --test-dir build/cpu-test -R '^http_server_test$'` passes.
- `cmake --build --preset pr` (the hosted contract suite) on this branch: 56/56 tests passed.
- `tools/ci/check-format.py` (clang-tools 21.1.8 via `nix shell`): PASS, 563 C++ files.
- Not run: sanitizers, functional tests or any model.
